title: November Game Audio Club
description:
If you’re into making video game music or sound design (or just curious) come hang out with us once a month! Doesn’t matter if you’re a pro or just starting out— everyone’s welcome. Just bring your love for game audio. Chill time where you can share your work, get feedback, or just vibe with people who love game audio. 
 
For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see: https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/317001810
location: St. Louis County Library - Clark Family Branch, 1640 S Lindbergh Blvd, St. Louis, MO 63131, USA

title: Game Club: Inside
description:
Game Club is like a book club except we pick a game to play each month and then meet up to discuss it with a focus on game design. This month's game is the dark indie puzzle platformer, INSIDE!
 
For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see: https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/317001958
location: Sauce on the Side, 701 N New Ballas Rd, Creve Coeur, MO 63141, USA

title: Share & Play: Game Playtesting!
description:
Join us for casual game playtesting! This is an opportunity for developers to share their progress, observe playtesting, and get feedback on their projects, and for local game enthusiasts to get their hands on new games, prototypes, and give helpful feedback. 
 
For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see: https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/314944382
location: St. Louis County Library - Clark Family branch - 1640 South Lindbergh Blvd - St. Louis, MO, us

title: November Gamedev Work Night
description:
St. Louis County Library Clark Family branch is hosting casual work time for local game developers in the Creative Lab. Bring your project to work on and talk with other devs for feedback or fun. This is open to EVERYONE ages 14 and up. 
 
For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see: https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/316934050
location: St. Louis County Library - Clark Family Branch, 1640 S Lindbergh Blvd, St. Louis, MO 63131, USA

title: STLGameDev Holiday Party
description:
Join us in celebrating another year of game development in St. Louis at our annual Holiday Party! We will have fun multiplayer games on a giant screen, retro consoles, STL-made games, and ornament making! It will be a great time to chat with other devs, make new friends, and find collaborators. Don't miss one of the biggest game dev events of the year! 
 
For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see: https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/317248375
location: Archportals, 1006 Olive St #3W, St. Louis, MO 63101, USA
